description: Near-real-time feed of what changed (GET /v1/changes). Poll with since=<ISO timestamp> to get everything newer than your cursor; with no since it defaults to the last hour. Reason types include NewBill, StatusChange, Text, Vote and Amendment. Use this for monitoring and incremental sync — 'what moved in Florida since yesterday' — rather than re-scanning search_bills.

reason.description: Restrict to one change type, e.g. NewBill, StatusChange, Text, Vote, Amendment.

since.description: ISO-8601 cursor. Omit for the last hour. Pass the newest timestamp you have already seen.

state.description: 2-letter postal code (e.g. FL), DC, or US for Congress.

name: get_changes
title: Get the bill change feed
